notes.title: Update - 20161110
notes.content:
Update - 20161110

- new jump mechanism: use the A button to jump, harmonizing the behaviour with the double-jump. This new mechanism can be enabled/disabled from the settings. That allows to play with the original controls or with the new ones, based on what you prefer.

Thank you for your feedbacks!

Blue Gate.
